name: Lightspeed Hero (CR 8) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Lightspeed Hero (CR 8) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Lightspeed Hero (CR 15)" but are not part of the Lightspeed Hero (CR 8) entry, which is unchanged.

OFFENSE

Speed 116 ft.(+10 exodus of speed, +30 fast movement, +5 fleet, +11 favored class bonus [elf ], +30 impossible speed)
Melee +2 ki intensifying katana +19/+14/+9 (1d8+6, 18-20) or unarmed strike +16/+11/+6 (2d6+3)
Ranged masterwork shuriken +17/+12/+7 (1d2+4), earthfire shurikenP50NoFS +17/+12 (1d2+5)
Special Attacks burst through, fleet charge, fleet warrior, flurry of blows (+2 attacks), ki strike (cold iron, lawful, magic, silver), mythic power 15/day, skirmisher’s challenge 1/day (+1 dodge to AC, +1 insight on saves), stunning fist 12/day (DC 24), style strike (defensive spin, spin kick) (1/round), surge +1d8
